source_clause: SHVS2. For Standard Heated/Vented seats a press of the vented seat button turns the seat on HI, the soft button highlights blue and control displays a large fan, HI and/or 2 LEDs. The next button press sets the seat to LO, button remains highlighted and displays a small fan, LO and/or 1 LED. The next press, turns the vented seat OFF, the button is no longer highlighted and a unhighlighted fan is shown.
reasoning: 驗證目標：12.9（SHVS2）以三句定出 Standard 通風座椅之三段循環及其藍色與風扇指示，三個 037 leaf 逐句對應。關鍵情境條件：同 12.8（第八軸之 Standard 值）；依 **R-C34** 三軸暴露 → 補，第十二軸亦補。為什麼這樣切：同 `12.8`。刻意略過：**本節末之「a unhighlighted fan is shown」與 `12.2` 之「no arrows are shown」形態不同**，各依其節之字面立 ER，不互相統一（§8.4.1）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: comfort section 之 Standard 通風座椅軟鍵
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: **暴露 → 全數補（本組首次以排除式使用第十二軸）** —— 座椅控制位於 comfort category 之 Seats 分頁，2.1 使 tabs 於僅前排氣候之車輛不顯示
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **排除補並逐條答（R-C36-1）** —— 逐條之答皆為 `no`：ch16 無加熱／通風座椅之行為節（僅 16.16 之座椅 off icon，其 leaf 已停下），見 DR #41 之形態

tcs.tc_title: A press of the standard vented seat button sets the seat to HI
tcs.test_item:
For Standard Heated/Vented seats a press of the vented seat button turns the seat on HI, the soft button highlights blue and control displays a large fan, HI and/or 2 LEDs.

(read the vented seat button and its control -> The button is highlighted blue and the control displays a large fan, HI and/or 2 LEDs)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has Standard Heated/Vented seats (12.8)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the vented seat button in the comfort section
2. Read the vented seat button and its control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The vented seat is on HI
2. The button is highlighted blue and the control displays a large fan, HI and/or 2 LEDs

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節中僅 `16.16`（ICE15）提及座椅圖示（「Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration」，其 leaf `122-02` 已停下），**無一節定義加熱／通風座椅、加熱方向盤或座椅分區之按壓循環、層級呈現或其 popup**；故本條之 EMEA 排除**無 ch16 對造句可依**，屬 R-C36-1 之過嚴側（同 DR #41 之形態）

tcs.test_item_authored: The system shall on a press of the vented seat button turn the seat on HI, with the soft button highlighted blue and the control displaying a large fan, HI and/or 2 LEDs
